sources.title: Türkiye: Draft Law Threatens LGBT People with Prison | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch news release (29 Oct 2025): a leaked omnibus draft (the '11th Judicial Package') would amend the penal and civil codes to criminalise LGBT conduct deemed 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' (up to 3 years), criminalise same-sex ceremonies (up to 4 years), raise the age for gender-affirming healthcare to 25 with mandatory infertility and multiple-evaluation conditions, and punish providers with fines and up to 7 years' imprisonment; 15 LGBT groups and the national medical association object.

Kaos GL (24 Feb 2026) on its LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025, 'The Year of the Family: A Major Siege': in 2025 hostility became explicit state policy (presidency-centred; a family ministry as implementing body; religious-authority and broadcasting-regulator restrictions; one LGBTI+ organisation closed); 6 right-to-life violations documented (3 recorded as hate-motivated, trans people most affected), 89 torture/ill-treatment violations (51 the previous year), 313 liberty violations (~2.5x the previous year); official hate-crime statistics are not kept.
